overallReport.summary: Riley performs best on average across both views and likes, making them the preferred host based on these metrics. Linus records the weakest results for both average views and average likes. While Riley leads in total views and likes, this is heavily influenced by their significantly higher upload volume compared to the other hosts. Elijah and Linus show lower total figures, though their rankings are less reliable due to their small sample sizes of only four and thirteen videos respectively.
